newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope tells Albanians to "Lay down your arms".
newsitem.headline: Pope tells Albanians to "Lay down your arms".

text.p: Pope John Paul urged Albanians on Sunday to end "destructive violence" and lay down their arms and said the whole of Europe had a duty to help rebuild the shattered Balkan country.

"For the good of Albania, I urge all those who have taken up arms to lay them down. Destructive violence is definitely not the right way to resolve social problems," the Pontiff said in a regular weekly address to pilgrims in St Peter's Square.

"These tragic events are a call to the whole of Europe -- it must help the leaders and the Albanian people to build their country on the basis of democracy and political and social dialogue," the Polish Pope said.
Albania has descended into armed anarchy this month in the wake of failed investment schemes which swallowed the savings of thousands and which Albanians have blamed on the government.
The Pope said trust in the authorities needed to be re-established. "That cannot be achieved without public order".

He called on pilgrims to pray for peace in Albania, saying the latest crisis to afflict Europe's poorest state, which had recently emerged from a "long period of inhuman dictatorship", had plunged its people into total insecurity.
